analysis_tools.py._Arguments: Validate only explicitly declared typed analysis-tool arguments; reject coercion and extra authority or environment fields.
analysis_tools.py.StartCommand: Request one bounded argv command under host-owned execution policy, identified by a stable operation key; its receipt is a job identity, not task acceptance.
analysis_tools.py.StartPython: Request bounded standard-library Python analysis through the host-selected interpreter, preserving the operation key rather than choosing credentials or an execution environment.
analysis_tools.py.ReadCommand: Read byte windows or briefly observe the existing job; offsets count bytes, max_bytes is per stream and a read never starts the command again.
analysis_tools.py.CancelCommand: Request cancellation of the existing attempt-owned job by its exact identity without accepting the task or creating replacement work.
analysis_tools.py._Owned: Retain one admitted command scope, worker and handle together with the shared cleanup task that preserves original resource ownership.
analysis_tools.py._window: Project one byte slice with exact base64, byte offsets and an explicitly lossy UTF-8 preview through the canonical output-window formatter.
analysis_tools.py._receipt: Render persisted job facts and requested stdout/stderr windows while keeping exit status, local closure and product acceptance separate.
analysis_tools.py.AnalysisTools.__aexit__: Drain shared cleanup of this attempt's original command resources before leaving the tool scope.
analysis_tools.py.AnalysisTools._authorized: Require local scope availability, the current host activity predicate and the durable attempt lease before dispatch or response delivery.
analysis_tools.py.AnalysisTools.call: Validate one admitted tool envelope and arguments, serialize owned command operations and recheck authority before returning results; uncertain effects require original receipt recovery.
analysis_tools.py.AnalysisTools._start: Recover the same durable command receipt or admit one new dedicated worker after prior jobs close, constraining cwd to the bound workspace without replaying uncertain work.
analysis_tools.py.AnalysisTools._get: Read a durable job only if its run and attempt match this tool scope, rejecting foreign job identities.
analysis_tools.py.AnalysisTools._settle: Close this scope's owned terminal or uncertain peer before rereading its durable receipt; unknown process outcome never becomes an invented exit code.
analysis_tools.py.AnalysisTools._read: Observe or cancel the original attempt-owned job, bound optional waiting and settle terminal peers; unowned uncertain work requires recovery instead of replay.
analysis_tools.py.AnalysisTools._close_owned: Share one shielded original scope-exit task and remove ownership only after cleanup completes, so a cancelled reader cannot abandon or reenter teardown.
analysis_tools.py.AnalysisTools.aclose: Start or join one shielded shutdown task, immediately preventing further admitted tool work while retaining the original cleanup owner.
analysis_tools.py.AnalysisTools._shutdown: Request physical worker closure before waiting for the tool lock, drain each original scope and mark closed only after successful cleanup.
